paragraphs: Peloton is a leading global fitness and wellness company that empowers people to live fit, strong, long, and happy, by bringing integrated fitness and wellness experiences to Members (as defined below) anytime, anywhere. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in New York City, we offer a breadth of fitness and wellness solutions to consumers worldwide, including our highly engaged community of approximately 5.5 million Members as of June 30, 2026, across the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, Australia, and Austria, and Commercial Business Unit customers in over 60 countries. As a category innovator at the nexus of fitness, wellness, technology, and media, we deliver integrated experiences through our world-renowned instructors ("Instructors"), premium hardware and innovative software, personalization, and extensive modalities and an expansive content library.

We define a "Member" as any individual who has a Peloton account through a Paid Connected Fitness Subscription or a Paid App Subscription, inclusive of the Peloton App+, App One, Strength+, and Breathwrk Memberships (our "Peloton Apps"), and engages in one or more workouts in the trailing 12-month period. We define workout engagement as either (i) completing the lesser of 50% or 10 minutes of Instructor-led classes, Scenic (guided, time, and distance-based routes filmed in locations around the world), and Lanebreak workouts (our game-inspired workout experience); (ii) at least 10 minutes of any activity tracking workout (such as "Just Ride", "Just Run", or "Just Row"), or Peloton Entertainment workout (video streaming); (iii) at least 5 minutes of any Strength+ workout with 80% of sets marked complete; or (iv) at least 10 minutes of any Breathwrk class.

We define a "Paid Connected Fitness Subscription" as a person, household, or commercial property, such as a hotel or residential building, that has paid for a subscription to a Connected Fitness Product (a Connected Fitness Subscription with a successful credit card billing or with prepaid subscription credits or waivers). "Paid App Subscriptions" include all subscriptions to our Peloton Apps for which we currently receive payment (a successful credit card billing or prepaid with subscription credits or waivers).

Our portfolio of Connected Fitness Products primarily consists of the Peloton Original Series, Peloton Cross Training Series, Peloton Pro Series, and Precor Products (each defined below, and collectively, the "Connected Fitness Products"), and related accessories, delivery and installation services, extended warranty and other service agreements, and branded apparel.

In connection with the launch of our Cross Training Series (as defined below), we discontinued the sale of our original series (the "Original Series," or "Original") Tread, Tread+, and Row. However, we continue to sell refurbished Original Bike and Original Bike+.

•Original Bike: Combines fitness, technology, and media, to connect riders to live and on-demand workouts led by Peloton Instructors, as well as alternative workout experiences like Peloton Entertainment, Scenic, and Lanebreak. It has an HD touchscreen and built-in speakers.

•Original Bike+: Includes all Original Bike features, and unlocks an even more dynamic workout experience with a rotating HD touchscreen, automatic resistance control with the Bike+ electronic braking system, and a more refined design. In select markets, we also provide the opportunity via the Peloton Rental program to rent the Original Bike+ and access fitness content for one monthly fee.

•Original Tread: Combines a cutting-edge treadmill design with Peloton's compelling Instructor-led Running, Walking, Hiking, and Tread Bootcamp content, as well as Entertainment, Scenic, and Lanebreak. It includes design elements unique to Peloton, like dial control knobs, jump buttons, and an auto-incline feature, as well as an HD touchscreen and built-in speakers.

•Original Tread+: Includes all Original Tread features, and unlocks an elevated comfort experience with slat belt technology, an upgraded touchscreen, Free Mode for self-powered running, and a powerful sound bar designed for a high-quality home workout experience.

•Original Row: Combines innovative software, premium hardware design, and exclusive Peloton content to deliver a unique low-impact, full-body cardio and strength workout. It features proprietary rowing form assistance and form guidance technology, personalized pace target technology, a rotating HD touchscreen and built-in speakers.

In October 2025, we launched the Cross Training Series, a refreshed portfolio of Connected Fitness Products, which includes the Cross Training Bike, Bike+, Tread, Tread+, and Row+ (collectively, the "Cross Training Series").
•Cross Training Bike: Includes all Original Bike features, and introduces a rotating HD touchscreen to switch seamlessly from Cycling to Strength, Yoga, Pilates, and more.

•Cross Training Bike+: Includes all Original Bike+ features, and introduces a movement-tracking camera powered by Peloton IQ for real-time form correction, repetition tracking, and weight suggestions, a three-speed fan for optimal airflow, an upgraded saddle, Sonos-tuned speakers, and hands-free control for the highest quality home workout experience.
•Cross Training Tread: Includes all Original Tread features, and introduces a rotating HD touchscreen to improve the off-treadmill workout experience.

paragraphs: Investing in our Class A common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including the section titled "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations," and our consolidated financial statements and the accompanying notes and the information included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K and our other public filings before deciding whether to invest in shares of our Class A common stock. These risks and uncertainties are not the only ones we face. If any of the following risks occur, our business, financial condition, operating results, and future prospects could be materially and adversely affected. In that event, the market price of our Class A common stock could decline, and you could lose part or all of your investment.

Although we reported net income in fiscal year 2026, we have incurred significant operating losses in prior periods and may not be able to sustain profitability on a quarterly or annual basis. Our operating expenses may increase as we invest in growth, including product development, content, marketing, and international expansion, and these efforts may be more costly than we expect. Our revenue may also decline due to, among other reasons, decreased numbers of subscribers, reduced demand, increased competition, or contraction of our overall market. If our revenue does not grow at a greater rate than our operating expenses, we will not be able to sustain profitability.

Our continued business and revenue growth may be dependent on our ability to continuously attract and retain Subscriptions, and we cannot be sure that we will be successful in these efforts, or that Subscription retention levels will not materially decline. There are a number of factors that could lead to a decline in Subscription levels or that could prevent us from increasing our Subscription levels, including:

•our failure to introduce new features, products, or services that Members find engaging or our introduction of new products or services, or changes to existing products and services that are not favorably received;
•harm to our brand and reputation; •pricing and perceived value of our offerings; •actual or perceived safety concerns regarding our products;
•unsatisfactory experiences with the delivery, installation, or servicing of our Connected Fitness Products;

Peloton is a leading global fitness and wellness company that empowers people to live fit, strong, long, and happy, by bringing integrated fitness and wellness experiences to Members (as defined below) anytime, anywhere. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in New York City, we offer a breadth of fitness and wellness solutions to consumers worldwide, including our highly engaged community of approximately 5.5 million Members as of June 30, 2026, across the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, Australia, and Austria, and Commercial Business Unit customers in over 60 countries. As a category innovator at the nexus of fitness, wellness, technology, and media, we deliver integrated experiences through our world-renowned instructors ("Instructors"), premium hardware and innovative software, personalization, extensive modalities and an expansive content library.

We define a "Member" as any individual who has a Peloton account through a Paid Connected Fitness Subscription (as defined below) or a Paid App Subscription, inclusive of the Peloton App+, App One, Strength+, and Breathwrk Memberships (our "Peloton Apps"), and engages in one or more workouts in the trailing 12-month period. We define workout engagement as either (i) completing the lesser of 50% or 10 minutes of Instructor-led classes, Scenic (guided, time, and distance-based routes filmed in locations around the world), and Lanebreak workouts (our game-inspired workout experience); (ii) at least 10 minutes of any activity tracking workout (such as "Just Ride", "Just Run", or "Just Row"), or Peloton Entertainment workout (video streaming); (iii) at least 5 minutes of any Strength+ workout with 80% of sets marked complete; or (iv) at least 10 minutes of any Breathwrk class.

Our portfolio of Connected Fitness Products primarily consists of the Peloton Original Series, Peloton Cross Training Series, Peloton Pro Series, and Precor Products (collectively, the "Connected Fitness Products"), and related accessories, delivery and installation services, extended warranty and other service agreements, and branded apparel. In October 2025, we launched the Cross Training Series, a refreshed portfolio of Connected Fitness Products, which includes the Cross Training Bike, Bike+, Tread, Tread+, and Row+ (collectively, the "Cross Training Series"). We also launched the Peloton Pro Series, a refresh of our portfolio of commercial-ready Peloton-branded products, which now includes the Bike+ Pro, Tread+ Pro, and Row+ Pro (collectively, the "Pro Series"). In connection with the Cross Training Series launch, we discontinued the sale of our original series (the "Original Series") Tread, Tread+, and Row; however we continue to sell the refurbished Original Series Bike and Bike+. Our Precor-branded fitness products include Precor Cardio, Precor Strength, Connected Fitness Solutions, and Wellness Solutions (collectively, the "Precor Products").

Access to the Peloton Apps is available with an All-Access Membership for Members who have Peloton-branded Connected Fitness Products or through a standalone App Membership (App+, App One, Strength+, and Breathwrk). Our revenue is generated primarily from recurring Subscription Revenue and the sale of our Connected Fitness Products. We define a "Paid Connected Fitness Subscription" as a person, household, or commercial property, such as a hotel or residential building, that has paid for a subscription to a Connected Fitness Product (a Connected Fitness Subscription with a successful credit card billing or with prepaid subscription credits or waivers). "Paid App Subscriptions" include all subscriptions to our Peloton Apps for which we currently receive payment (a successful credit card billing or prepaid with subscription credits or waivers).

Our financial profile has been characterized by strong retention, recurring revenue, and efficient customer acquisition. We believe that our low Average Net Monthly Paid Connected Fitness Subscription Churn, together with our high Subscription Gross Profit and Subscription Contribution Margin, yields an attractive lifetime value ("LTV") for our Connected Fitness Subscriptions well in excess of our customer acquisition costs ("CAC"). Maintaining an attractive LTV/CAC ratio is a primary goal of our customer acquisition strategy.

In August 2025, we announced a restructuring plan (the "2025 Restructuring Plan"), which included a reduction in global headcount and was designed to improve our cost structure, operating efficiency, and profitability, while providing us the opportunity to return to growth by reinvesting expected savings into our differentiating capabilities. The 2025 Restructuring Plan has been substantially implemented as of June 30, 2026. We do not expect to incur material additional cash or non-cash restructuring charges under the 2025 Restructuring Plan.

On February 20, 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court issued a decision invalidating tariffs imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act ("IEEPA"). U.S. Customs and Border Protection ("CBP") subsequently launched the Consolidated Administration and Processing of Entries ("CAPE") process to permit importers to seek refunds on previously paid IEEPA tariffs. The Company submitted refund claims in CAPE in June 2026 for IEEPA tariffs previously paid by the Company.

Subsequent to June 30, 2026, the Company began to receive refund payments for IEEPA tariffs previously paid. Consistent with ASC 450-30, we did not recognize these amounts in the Consolidated Statements of Operations and Comprehensive Income (Loss) for the period ending June 30, 2026. We continue to closely monitor updates from CBP and will recognize any IEEPA tariff refunds or related receivables when they are realized or realizable.

Following the ruling on IEEPA tariffs, we were subject to Section 122 tariffs of 10%, which expired on July 23, 2026. Concurrently, effective July 24, 2026, the U.S. government imposed new tariffs of 10.0% to 12.5% on goods from approximately 60 economies under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974, including from economies where we have significant operations or commercial presence, such as Taiwan and China.

Additionally, on April 2, 2026, President Trump issued a presidential proclamation modifying the application of Section 232 tariffs on steel, aluminum, and their derivative products, which, among other things, removed fitness equipment from the scope of those tariffs. As a result, as of April 6, 2026, the steel and aluminum content in our Connected Fitness Products is no longer subject to Section 232 tariffs of 50%.

We will continue to closely monitor changes in international trade policies, relations, legislation and regulations, including those related to tariffs, which could adversely impact the global economy and our business, financial condition, and operating results. The impact of any tariffs will depend on various factors, including whether certain tariffs are ultimately implemented, the timing of implementation, any nullification or repeal, and the amount, scope and nature of the tariffs.

As previously disclosed, on November 6, 2025, in collaboration with the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission and Health Canada, we announced a voluntary recall of about 833,000 units in the U.S. and 44,800 units in Canada of the Original Series Bike+ (not Cross Training Bike+). We are offering Members a free replacement seat post as the approved remedy.

paragraphs: Peloton 是一家領先的全球健身與 wellness 公司，透過提供整合式健身與 wellness 經驗，賦能人們過著健康、強壯、長壽且快樂的生活，隨時隨地為會員（如下文所定義）提供服務。Peloton 於 2012 年成立，總部設於紐約市，我們為全球消費者提供廣泛的健身與 wellness 解決方案，包括截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日約 5.5 百萬名會員，分佈於美國、英國、加拿大、德國、澳洲與奧地利，以及超過 60 個國家的商業業務單位客戶。作為健身、wellness、科技與媒體領域的創新領導者，我們透過世界聞名的講師（"講師"）、高階硬體與創新軟體、個人化服務、廣泛的運動模式與龐大的內容庫存，提供整合式體驗。

我們將 "會員" 定義為任何擁有 Peloton 帳號並透過付費連線健身訂閱或付費應用程式訂閱（包含 Peloton 應用程式 +、App One、Strength+ 與 Breathwrk 訂閱（我們的 "Peloton 應用程式"）），且在最近 12 個月內參與至少一次訓練的個人。我們將訓練參與定義為以下任一情形：(i) 完成少於 50% 或 10 分鐘的教練帶領課程、Scenic（全球各地拍攝的導覽、時間與距離為基準的路線）、以及 Lanebreak 訓練（我們的遊戲風格訓練體驗）；(ii) 進行至少 10 分鐘的任何活動追蹤訓練（如 "Just Ride"、"Just Run" 或 "Just Row"），或 Peloton 娛樂訓練（影片串流）；(iii) 進行至少 5 分鐘的任何 Strength+ 訓練，且 80% 的訓練組數標記為完成；或 (iv) 進行至少 10 分鐘的任何 Breathwrk 課程。
我們將 "付費連線健身訂閱" 定義為個人、家庭或商業財產（如飯店或住宅大樓）已為連線健身產品（連線健身訂閱，包含成功信用卡結帳或預付訂閱信用額或豁免）付款。"付費應用程式訂閱" 包含所有我們目前收取費用的 Peloton 應用程式訂閱（成功信用卡結帳或預付訂閱信用額或豁免）。
我們的連線健身產品組合主要包含 Peloton 原始系列、Peloton 跨訓練系列、Peloton Pro 系列與 Precor 產品（各項定義如下，合稱 "連線健身產品"），以及相關配件、配送與安裝服務、延長保固及其他服務協議，以及品牌服飾。
配合我們跨訓練系列（定義如下）的發佈，我們已停止銷售原始系列（"原始系列" 或 "原始"）的 Tread、Tread+ 與 Row。然而，我們仍持續銷售翻新過的原始自行車與原始自行車+。
•原始自行車：結合健身、科技與媒體，連結騎士與 Peloton 教練的實時與點播訓練，以及 Peloton 娛樂、Scenic 與 Lanebreak 等其他訓練體驗。它具備 HD 觸控螢幕與內建喇叭。
•原始自行車+：包含所有原始自行車的功能，並解鎖更動態的訓練體驗，具備旋轉 HD 觸控螢幕、自動阻力控制與自行車+ 電子剎車系統，以及更精緻的設計。在部分市場，我們也透過 Peloton 租賃計畫提供租賃原始自行車+ 並以每月費用取得健身內容的機會。
•原始跑步機：結合先進的跑步機設計與 Peloton 強大的教練帶領跑步、步行、健行與跑步機訓練內容，以及娛樂、Scenic 與 Lanebreak 等其他訓練體驗。它包含 Peloton 獨有的設計元素，如調節按鈕、跳躍按鈕與自動坡度功能，以及 HD 觸控螢幕與內建喇叭。
•Original Tread+: 包含所有 Original Tread 功能，並解鎖提升的舒適體驗，包含格柵皮帶技術、升級的觸控螢幕、Free Mode 自動供電跑步模式，以及專為高品質居家訓練體驗設計的強大音響列陣。
•Original Row: 結合創新軟體、高階硬體設計與獨家 Peloton 內容，提供獨特的低衝擊、全身有氧與力量訓練。其具備專利的划船姿勢輔助與指導技術、個人化節奏目標技術、旋轉 HD 觸控螢幕與內建喇叭。
2025 年 10 月，本公司推出 Cross Training 系列，為 Connected Fitness 產品組合的更新版本，包含 Cross Training Bike、Bike+、Tread、Tread+ 與 Row+（合稱為 "Cross Training 系列"）。
•Cross Training Bike: 包含所有 Original Bike 功能，並引入旋轉 HD 觸控螢幕，可順暢切換 Cycling 到 Strength、Yoga、Pilates 等多種訓練模式。
•Cross Training Bike+: 包含所有 Original Bike+ 功能，並引入由 Peloton IQ 驅動的動作追蹤相機，用以實時姿勢修正、動作次數追蹤與重量建議，三速風扇以達成最佳空氣流通、升級的座墊、Sonos 調校喇叭，以及無需手持控制的高品質居家訓練體驗。
•Cross Training Tread: 包含所有 Original Tread 功能，並引入旋轉 HD 觸控螢幕，以提升離跑步機的訓練體驗。

Peloton 是一家全球領先的健身與健康公司，透過提供整合的健身與健康體驗，賦能人們過著健康、強壯、長壽且快樂的生活。Peloton 於 2012 年成立，總部設於紐約市，為全球消費者提供廣泛的健身與健康解決方案，包括我們高度參與的會員羣體，截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日約為 5.5 百萬名會員，遍及美國、英國、加拿大、德國、澳洲與奧地利，以及超過 60 個國家的商業業務單位客戶。作為健身、健康、科技與媒體領域的創新領導者，我們透過世界知名的教練（「教練」）、高階硬體與創新軟體、個人化、廣泛的運動模式與龐大的內容庫存，提供整合的體驗。

我們將「會員」定義為任何擁有 Peloton 帳戶的個人，透過已付費的連線健身訂閱（如下所定）或已付費的應用程式訂閱，並在最近 12 個月內參與至少一次運動的個體。我們將運動參與定義為以下任一情形：(i) 完成少於 50% 或 10 分鐘的教練帶領課程、Scenic（全球各地拍攝的導覽、時間與距離為基準的路線）、以及 Lanebreak 運動（我們的遊戲風格運動體驗）；(ii) 進行至少 10 分鐘的任何活動追蹤運動（例如「Just Ride」、「Just Run」或「Just Row」），或 Peloton 娛樂運動（視訊串流）；(iii) 進行至少 5 分鐘的任何 Strength+ 運動，且 80% 的訓練組數標記為完成；或 (iv) 進行至少 10 分鐘的任何 Breathwrk 課程。

我們的連線健身產品組合主要由 Peloton 原始系列、Peloton 跨訓練系列、Peloton Pro 系列與 Precor 產品（合稱為「連線健身產品」），以及相關配件、配送與安裝服務、延長保固及其他服務協議，以及品牌服飾組成。於 2025 年 10 月，我們推出了跨訓練系列，這是一組更新的連線健身產品，包括跨訓練自行車、自行車 Plus、跑步機、跑步機 Plus 與划船機 Plus（合稱為「跨訓練系列」）。我們也推出了 Peloton Pro 系列，這是我們商業用途的 Peloton 品牌產品組合的更新版本，現在包括自行車 Plus Pro、跑步機 Plus Pro 與划船機 Plus Pro（合稱為「Pro 系列」）。配合跨訓練系列的推出，我們停止銷售原始系列（「原始系列」）的跑步機、跑步機 Plus 與划船機；不過我們仍繼續銷售原始系列自行車與自行車 Plus 的翻新版本。我們的 Precor 品牌健身產品包括 Precor 卡路里、Precor 力量、連線健身解決方案與健康解決方案（合稱為「Precor 產品」）。

Peloton 應用程式的存取方式，可透過 All-Access 會員資格，為擁有 Peloton 品牌連線健身產品的會員提供，或透過獨立的應用程式會員資格（App+、App One、Strength+ 與 Breathwrk）提供。我們的收入主要來自於持續性訂閱收入與連線健身產品的銷售。我們將「已付費連線健身訂閱」定義為已為連線健身產品訂閱付款的個人、家庭或商業財產（如酒店或住宅大樓）（連線健身訂閱已成功信用卡扣款或預付訂閱金額或豁免）。『已付費應用程式訂閱』包括所有我們目前收到付款的 Peloton 應用程式訂閱（成功信用卡扣款或預付訂閱金額或豁免）。
我們的財務表現特徵為強大的留存率、持續性收入與高效的客戶獲取。我們認為，我們的低平均淨月度已付費連線健身訂閱流失率，加上我們的高訂閱毛利率與訂閱貢獻毛利，使我們的連線健身訂閱的生命週期價值（「LTV」）遠高於客戶獲取成本（「CAC」）。維持一個有吸引力的 LTV/CAC 比率是我們客戶獲取策略的主要目標。
於 2025 年 8 月，我們宣佈了一項重整計畫（「2025 重整計畫」），包括全球員工數量的減少，旨在改善我們的成本結構、營運效率與利潤率，同時提供我們透過預期節省的資金重新投資於我們差異化能力的機會，以重返成長。2025 重整計畫已於 2026 年 6 月 30 日 substantially 實施。我們不預期在 2025 重整計畫下產生重大額外的現金或非現金重整費用。
2026年2月20日，美國最高法院作出判決，廢止根據國際緊急經濟權力法（"IEEPA"）所課徵的關稅。美國國務院與邊境保護局（"CBP"）隨後啟動合併申報與處理程序（"CAPE"），允許進口商申請先前支付的IEEPA關稅退款。本公司於2026年6月透過CAPE程序提交退款申報，申報先前由本公司支付的IEEPA關稅。
2026年6月30日後，本公司開始收到先前支付IEEPA關稅的退款款項。根據ASC 450-30，我們於2026年6月30日結息期間的合併營運成果與綜合損益（損失）表中，未將這些金額確認為收入。我們持續密切關注CBP的更新資訊，並在這些IEEPA關稅退款或相關應收款項實現或可實現時進行確認。
根據IEEPA關稅的判決結果，本公司受到第122條關稅的10%影響，該關稅於2026年7月23日到期。同時，自2026年7月24日起，美國政府根據1974年貿易法第301條，對來自約60個經濟體的商品課徵10.0%至12.5%的新關稅，包括我們有重大營運或商業存在的經濟體，例如臺灣與中國。
此外，2026年4月2日，特朗普總統發布行政命令，修改根據第232條對鋼鐵、鋁及其衍生產品的關稅適用範圍，其中包括將健身器材從該關稅範圍中移除。因此，自2026年4月6日起，我們的Connected Fitness Products中鋼鐵與鋁的含量不再受第232條50%關稅的影響。
我們將持續密切關注國際貿易政策、關係、法律與法規的變動，包括與關稅相關的內容，這些變動可能對全球經濟與我們的業務、財務狀況與營運成果產生不利影響。任何關稅的影響將取決於多種因素，包括特定關稅是否最終實施、實施時間、任何廢止或廢除，以及關稅的金額、範圍與性質。
如先前披露，2025年11月6日，我們與美國消費者產品安全委員會及加拿大衛生部合作，宣佈 voluntarily recall 約833,000臺於美國與44,800臺於加拿大的Original Series Bike+（不包括Cross Training Bike+）。我們為會員提供免費更換的座墊作為核准的解決方案。

headings: 與我們業務相關的風險
我們過去曾產生營運虧損，未來可能繼續產生營運虧損，且未來可能無法維持獲利能力。
我們可能無法吸引並留住訂閱戶，這可能會對我們的業務及成長速度產生不利影響。
若我們無法準確預測消費者對我們產品及服務的需求，並適當管理我們的存貨，我們的營運結果已受到，且未來可能繼續受到不利影響。
我們過去的財務表現可能無法反映我們未來的績效。
我們的成功取決於我們維持 Peloton 品牌價值與聲譽的能力。
美國及國際貿易政策的變動，包括課徵關稅，已對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運結果產生，且可能繼續產生不利影響。
若我們的資訊科技系統或網站發生重大中斷或故障，或我們未能有效實施升級與新技術，可能會對我們的業務及營運產生不利影響。
我們所處的市場為高度競爭，我們可能無法成功對抗現有及未來的競爭對手。
我們的業務可能因意外事故、安全事件或勞動力中斷而受到不利影響。
我們的業務歷來並可能持續受到季節性影響。
我們的營運成果及其他營運指標可能因季度而異，使這些指標難以預測。
我們整合及運作 Precor 會產生風險，我們可能無法實現對 Precor 所有權的預期戰略及財務目標。
擴展至國際市場將使我們面臨重大風險。
paragraphs: 投資本公司的A類普通股涉及高度風險。您應仔細考慮下列所描述的風險與不確定性，並配合本年度報告表10-K所包含的所有資訊，包括「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」一節，以及我們的合併財務報表與附註說明，以及其他處於本年度報告表10-K中與我們其他公開申報文件的資訊，以決定是否投資本公司A類普通股。這些風險與不確定性並非我們唯一面臨的風險。若任何上述風險發生，將可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果與未來展望造成重大且不利的影響。在此情況下，本公司A類普通股的市場價格可能下跌，您可能損失部分或全部投資。
儘管我們在財務年度2026年報出淨收入，但我們在過去期間已產生顯著的營運虧損，且可能無法維持每季或每年的獲利能力。我們的營運費用可能因投資成長而增加，包括產品開發、內容、行銷與國際擴張，而這些努力可能比預期更昂貴。我們的收入也可能因訂閱人數減少、需求下降、競爭增加或整體市場收縮等因素而減少。若我們的收入成長率未能大於營運費用成長率，我們將無法維持獲利能力。
我們持續的業務與收入成長可能取決於我們持續吸引並保留訂閱的能力建立，我們無法確定我們是否能成功進行這些努力，或訂閱保留率不會大幅下降。許多因素可能導致訂閱數量下降，或使我們無法提高訂閱數量，包括：
•未能推出成員認為吸引人的新功能、產品或服務，或推出新產品或服務，或對現有產品與服務的變更未受到歡迎；
•我們品牌與聲譽受到損害；•我們產品的價格與價值感知；•實際或被認為與我們產品相關的安全問題；
•與我們連線健身產品的配送、安裝或維修服務體驗不滿意；
